blinding: Fresh model session; no prior reference, reader judgments, author labels, repair memo or coordinator verdict read. Diagnosis definitions and anchors disclosed. Initial oversized allowed packet read was truncated; partial raw text seen before this protocol; complete systematic reading begins after this file. Not human review or perfect blinding.
reading: Read every saved full eligibility string, brief/detailed study description, conditions, design phase/purpose, and all arm/cohort descriptions for all 37 trials. Record exact raw JSON pointers, byte hashes and verbatim text evidence. Check every relevant cohort before aggregate label.
rules: Disease-level compatibility is conditional on all remaining clinical and protocol requirements.
Explicit diagnosis outranks exact defining fusion, molecular class, broad tumor within compatible cohorts.
Direct exclusion or closed positive histology lists restrict the same cohort; reconcile other cohorts before trial-level exclusion.
Additional biomarkers are unestablished in hypothetical diagnosis; ambiguous mutation versus fusion acceptance remains unresolved.
Registry hold language is conditional unless an unconditional hold is stated. Snapshot recruiting status is not verified current site or cohort availability.
Full external protocol unavailable: preserve uncertainty, do not infer unseen criteria.
Nononcology false hits receive explicit task-domain distinction. Study purpose is orthogonal to disease scope.
No unjudged records become negatives; 149-pair expansion is a separate task.
freeze: Write independent-labels.json and source-evidence.json, then hash/timestamp freeze receipt before opening reference.json. Retain immutable independent labels in final adjudicated reference.
validation: 49 unique pairs, 33 metadata and 18 challenge memberships with two overlaps, 37 trials; preserve original strata and snapshots; resolve all source pointers, verify byte hashes and exact excerpts; reproducible script, manifest and run timing.
